packet.headline_seed: AI chipmaker Groq confirms $650M raise, re-staffs after Nvidia’s $20B not-acqui-hire deal
packet.description_seed: What does an AI company do after one of those not-acqui-hire deals? Groq raised money, is leaning into its neocloud business, and hiring new execs.

what: AI chipmaker Groq confirms $650M raise, re-staffs after Nvidia’s $20B not-acqui-hire deal

clean_source_blocks.text: What does an AI company do after one of those not-acqui-hire deals? Groq raised money, is leaning into its neocloud business, and hiring new execs.

What does an AI company do after one of those not-acqui-hire deals, where a rival pays investors a hefty IP “licensing” fee while poaching its critical talent? For AI chipmaker Groq, the answer appears to be raise more money from investors — who were said to have profited handsomely after a deal with Nvidia in December — hire more talent, and pivot. On Monday, Groq announced a new $650 million funding round, confirming earlier reports. The raise comes roughly six months after Nvidia signed a non-exclusive licensing agreement for Groq’s technology and hired away founder and CEO Jonathan Ross, president Sunny Madra, and other employees. Groq did not disclose its new valuation. It was last valued at $6.9 billion following a $750 million round in September. ---

The company is being led on an interim basis by CEO Adam Winter and CFO Matt Eng. Several top-level senior employees departed to Nvidia as part of the December deal. What remains is Groq’s inference cloud business, which lets developers and enterprises host inference-heavy applications on Groq’s proprietary Language Processing Unit hardware. TNW City Coworking space - Where your best work happens A workspace designed for growth, collaboration, and endless networking opportunities in the heart of tech. Inference, the processing that happens after an AI prompt is submitted, is now a much larger market than model training. Every ChatGPT query, every Claude response, every AI agent action requires inference compute. The economics favour purpose-built silicon that can deliver tokens at lower cost and higher speed than general-purpose GPUs.

After Nvidia’s $20B not-acqui-hire, Groq is raising $650M from existing investors for its inference cloud. Two backers guarantee the round. Groq is raising $650 million from existing investors to fund its inference cloud business, Axios reported. The raise comes six months after Nvidia struck a $20 billion not-acqui-hire that paid out Groq’s investors in cash, took several senior engineers, and licensed Groq’s hardware technology. The same investors who were cashed out in December have now been asked to reinvest. Disruptive and Infinitium have agreed to fill the round if other existing investors decline their pro-rata shares. The funding is, in effect, guaranteed.

[Lähde: TechCrunch]
What does an AI company do after one of those not-acqui-hire deals, where a rival pays investors a hefty IP “licensing” fee while poaching its critical talent? For AI chipmaker Groq, the answer appears to be raise more money from investors — who were said to have profited handsomely after a deal with Nvidia in December — hire more talent, and pivot.

The raise comes roughly six months after Nvidia signed a non-exclusive licensing agreement for Groq’s technology and hired away founder and CEO Jonathan Ross, president Sunny Madra, and other employees. Groq did not disclose its new valuation. It was last valued at $6.9 billion following a $750 million round in September.

---

[Lähde: The Next Web]
After Nvidia’s $20B not-acqui-hire, Groq is raising $650M from existing investors for its inference cloud. Two backers guarantee the round.

Groq is raising $650 million from existing investors to fund its inference cloud business, Axios reported. The raise comes six months after Nvidia struck a $20 billion not-acqui-hire that paid out Groq’s investors in cash, took several senior engineers, and licensed Groq’s hardware technology.

The same investors who were cashed out in December have now been asked to reinvest. Disruptive and Infinitium have agreed to fill the round if other existing investors decline their pro-rata shares. The funding is, in effect, guaranteed.

The company is being led on an interim basis by CEO Adam Winter and CFO Matt Eng. Several top-level senior employees departed to Nvidia as part of the December deal. What remains is Groq’s inference cloud business, which lets developers and enterprises host inference-heavy applications on Groq’s proprietary Language Processing Unit hardware.

TNW City Coworking space - Where your best work happens

A workspace designed for growth, collaboration, and endless networking opportunities in the heart of tech.

Inference, the processing that happens after an AI prompt is submitted, is now a much larger market than model training. Every ChatGPT query, every Claude response, every AI agent action requires inference compute. The economics favour purpose-built silicon that can deliver tokens at lower cost and higher speed than general-purpose GPUs.

Groq’s LPU architecture was designed specifically for this workload. The company has shipped its chips to multiple model providers and cloud customers. Its inference speed, measured in tokens per second, has consistently benchmarked above Nvidia’s GPU-based inference at comparable price points.

The $20 billion December deal was unusual. It was not a full acquisition. Nvidia paid Groq’s investors in cash at what would have been Nvidia’s largest-ever purchase price. It licensed Groq’s chip technology. It took senior engineers. But it did not absorb the company. The result is a Groq that has been financially reset, technically depleted at the senior level, and now raising to rebuild around a narrower but potentially lucrative inference-as-a-service model.

The inference chip market is attracting capital at an extraordinary rate. Cerebras went public at a $95 billion valuation on an inference-optimised pitch. Fractile raised $220 million in London for inference

payload.title: Groq keräsi 650 miljoonaa dollaria Nvidian kanssa tehdyn järjestelyn jälkeen
payload.summary: Tekoälysiruja kehittävä Groq on vahvistanut 650 miljoonan dollarin rahoituskierroksen ja keskittyy aiempaa selvemmin päättelylaskennan pilvipalveluihin.
payload.content:
Tekoälysiruja kehittävä Groq on vahvistanut 650 miljoonan dollarin rahoituskierroksen noin puoli vuotta sen jälkeen, kun Nvidia lisensoi yhtiön teknologiaa ja palkkasi useita sen keskeisiä työntekijöitä. Groq ei kertonut uutta arvostustaan, mutta yhtiö oli viimeksi arvostettu 6,9 miljardiin dollariin syyskuussa toteutetun 750 miljoonan dollarin rahoituskierroksen jälkeen.

## Johto vaihtui järjestelyn jälkeen

Joulukuun järjestelyssä Nvidia teki Groqin teknologiaa koskevan ei-yksinomaisen lisenssisopimuksen ja palkkasi muun muassa perustaja-toimitusjohtaja Jonathan Rossin, presidentti Sunny Madran sekä muita työntekijöitä. Useita ylimmän tason työntekijöitä siirtyi Nvidialle osana kokonaisuutta.

Groqia johtavat nyt väliaikaisesti toimitusjohtaja Adam Winter ja talousjohtaja Matt Eng. Yhtiön jäljelle jääväksi painopisteeksi on noussut sen päättelylaskennan pilviliiketoiminta, jossa kehittäjät ja yritykset voivat ajaa runsaasti päättelyä vaativia tekoälysovelluksia Groqin omalla Language Processing Unit -laitteistolla.

## Päättelylaskenta on yhtiön uusi keskus

Päättelyllä tarkoitetaan laskentaa, joka tapahtuu sen jälkeen, kun käyttäjä on antanut tekoälylle kehotteen. Jokainen keskustelubotin vastaus ja tekoälyagentin toiminto tarvitsee tällaista laskentaa. Lähteiden mukaan päättely on nyt mallien kouluttamista suurempi markkina, ja tarkoitukseen suunniteltu piiri voi tarjota tokeneita alemmalla kustannuksella ja suuremmalla nopeudella kuin yleiskäyttöiset grafiikkasuorittimet.

Uusi 650 miljoonan dollarin kierros kerätään nykyisiltä sijoittajilta. Sen tarkoituksena on rahoittaa Groqin päättelypilveä. Samat sijoittajat, jotka saivat rahaa joulukuun järjestelyssä, on nyt pyydetty sijoittamaan uudelleen. Disruptive ja Infinitium ovat sitoutuneet täyttämään kierroksen, jos muut nykyiset sijoittajat eivät käytä omia pro rata -osuuksiaan, joten rahoitus on käytännössä varmistettu.

## Seuraava vaihe rakentuu pilvipalvelun varaan

Groqin tilanne on poikkeuksellinen, koska Nvidia vei mukanaan osan sen avainosaamisesta ja lisensoi samalla sen laitteistoteknologiaa. Uusi rahoitus antaa yhtiölle kuitenkin mahdollisuuden jatkaa itsenäisenä toimijana ja rakentaa liiketoimintaa sen ympärille, mitä sille jäi: päättelylaskennan pilvi, oma LPU-laitteisto sekä asiakkaina kehittäjät ja yritykset, jotka tarvitsevat paljon tekoälyn vastauslaskentaa.
summary_bullets: Groq vahvisti 650 miljoonan dollarin rahoituskierroksen nykyisiltä sijoittajiltaan.
Rahoitus tulee noin puoli vuotta sen jälkeen, kun Nvidia lisensoi Groqin teknologiaa ja palkkasi useita sen johtajia ja työntekijöitä.
Yhtiö keskittyy nyt päättelylaskennan pilvipalveluun, joka hyödyntää sen omaa Language Processing Unit -laitteistoa.
